boundary: The portable receipt is historical evidence, not an authenticated authority. Owner checks remain in-process, and each receiving invocation must freshly replay its route.
next: Investigate separately verifiable owner and source-pin attestations for an independent-process receiver; withhold proof when identity cannot be authenticated.
observation: A new receiving invocation re-audited the exact pinned route twice, independently completed two tasks and withheld one missing edge. Another invocation replayed again; revoked pins rejected the old receipt.
preserved: Exact source pins and route fingerprints, separate task obligations, no borrowing from another route, zero new owner-edge observations, and prior checkpoint evidence.
summary: A portable historical route receipt can be freshly revalidated for independently declared tasks in a later invocation.
title: Cross-invocation certificate handoff
